# Lauren Pires

> Lauren Pires is an award-winning TEDx and invisible disability keynote speaker based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. She helps organizations explore disability-related biases and beliefs to create inclusive cultures and build resilience through joy. She speaks in person across North America and virtually.

Lauren was born with Central Core Disease, a rare neuromuscular disorder, and hid her disability for 30 years before becoming one of Canada's most visible invisible disability and rare disease advocates. Her signature idea is the "Daily Yay": small moments of joy that build resilience.

## Keynotes

- [Beyond What You See: Building Inclusion for Invisible Disabilities](https://laurensaysyay.com/speaking/): what invisible disabilities are and how workplaces can include the people who live with them.
- [Bias, Belief and Belonging: Rewriting Narratives on Disability and Acceptance](https://laurensaysyay.com/speaking/): the stories we tell about disability and how to change them.
- [Seeking Strength: How to Build Resilience Through Small Moments of Joy](https://laurensaysyay.com/speaking/): resilience through the Daily Yay.
- [Everyday Ableism and How to Recognize It](https://laurensaysyay.com/speaking/): spotting and stopping everyday ableism at work.
- [TEDxMississauga 2026: How can we fit in without losing who we are?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SWVUgHY3ibM): her TEDx talk, over 45,000 views.

## Recognition

- First Canadian recipient of the Invisible Disabilities Association "But You LOOK Good" Inspiration Award
- Canada's first and only Invisible Disabilities Association Ambassador (2023)
- D-30 Disability Impact List honouree, Diversability (2024)
- One of the faces of the global Rare Disease Day 2024 campaign (EURORDIS)
- Led #LightUpForRare for Rare Disease Day 2026: 26 landmarks lit across 18 Canadian cities
- Rick Hansen Foundation School Program Ambassador (2026)
- #2 Inspirational Speaker of the Year, Speaker Slam Grand Slam (2023)

## Clients

Health Canada, Arc'teryx, McKesson Canada, The Co-operators, Rick Hansen Foundation, Employment and Social Development Canada (ESDC), GreenShield, Embark, GroupHealth and Guelph-Humber, among others.

## Media

CTV Your Morning, Breakfast Television, CityNews Toronto, Global News, CHCH, OMNI News and SiriusXM Canada, among others. See [Media](https://laurensaysyay.com/media/).
